method: Real operator login with read-only GETs and page navigation; no action button pressed. BFF and registry CPU read per call or per second from /proc/1/stat utime plus stime inside the containers with read-only commands; these numbers include work for other clients running at the same time.

baseline.source: 2026-11-09 BFF e88fcf0a9 and a pre-fix control on 2026-11-10 BFF 39f80bb95 for the detail routes
baseline.list: 8157 ms alone with 6.84 BFF CPU s; 13895 14415 27424 ms with overlapping page loads
baseline.bff_persona_detail: 6418 ms about 4.8 CPU s on 2026-11-09; control 10 repeats p50 5213 ms min 4088 max 6078 CPU p50 3.45 s; a 1641 byte persona took 5312 to 6426 ms
baseline.persona_management_detail: 7424 ms about 4.5 CPU s on 2026-11-09; control 10 repeats p50 6485 ms min 4721 max 7099 CPU p50 4.16 s

earlier_run_same_pair.concurrent_traffic_from_other_clients_in: trading-pulse 11 and trading-pulse rankings 11 and nl/ask 5 and performance-attribution 4

list.explanation: The removal is the documented shape change of PR 7105; the only frontend reader (personaFleetDataSources.ts) reads /bff/management/persona-fleet whose code path these changes did not touch. The one state change is an owner change.

detail.compared: 3 personas times 2 routes against pre-fix captures on 39f80bb95 at 2026-11-10T02:1xZ
detail.persona_management_1_and_3: only meta.snapshot_at and allowed_actions staleness changed
detail.bff_persona_825kb: connector freshness and source health values changed after the Taiwan source refresh that ran in the deploy; no code between the two versions touches the source health overlay
detail.persona_management_2448: latestTelemetry gained positions and trade and drawdown fields because the persona started paper trading meanwhile

responses_equal_baseline_except_owner_ch.routed_count_equivalence: Before the fix the count view equalled the full read for 12 personas including all 6 with zero; after the fix /bff/strategies?persona_id= item counts equal routedStrategies for 7 personas including 3 with zero; /bff/strategies total 3377 versus 3376 before

limitations: The BFF is one Python process, so heavy concurrent requests from other clients serialize with these reads under the GIL. In the first 10 repeat run on the same pair 5 of 10 /bff/personas/{id} and 6 of 10 persona-management calls exceeded 3 s (max 13.7 s) while trading-pulse was polled about every 10 s and Management AI questions ran; the interleaved run with lighter load had none over 3 s. Per call CPU numbers include that other work.

The persona detail page is ready in 6.4 s instead of 10.6 to 11.5 s. It is now dominated by /bff/strategies?persona_id= which still reads and normalizes every strategy spec (2.0 to 3.5 s alone and 7.4 s on the page while sharing the GIL); that route was out of scope.

PR 7116 also aligned strategy spec normalization in research_knowledge_source.py (metadata fallbacks for lifecycle and persona ids), which can change /bff/strategies output for specs that only carry those values in metadata; the checks above found no change.
Unrelated and unchanged by these fixes: /bff/management/persona-fleet rows carry no connectorHealth and the data sources page shows 0 sources.
Response equality is checked against pre-fix captures and the 2026-11-09 list baseline; values that the owners changed in between are explained above rather than frozen.
